info.title: Finance App API
info.description:
Personal finance management platform.

This document is **generated from the running Express app** by `npm run generate:openapi`, so the paths, parameters and request bodies below are the ones the server actually enforces. It is committed to the repository and checked in CI, which is what stops it from drifting.

Money crosses this API as a **decimal string**, never a JSON number. Every amount is stored as `NUMERIC(19,4)`.

Response schemas are authored beside the service that produces the row, and are checked against real responses by the test suite. An operation that still answers `2XX` with no content is one whose shape has not been described yet.

bearerAuth.description: A short-lived access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` or `/auth/refresh`. Refresh tokens are opaque, rotate on every use, and are tracked in families.

availableBalance.description: Cleared balance plus anything still pending — what is really committed. A decimal string.

creditLimit.description: Credit-card accounts only; `null` on every other type.

actor.description: Null when the event was raised by a background job rather than a person.

config.description: Rule-specific settings; the keys depend on `type`. See `docs/api.md`.

scopeCategoryId.description: Narrows the rule to one category; null means the whole workspace.

includeSubcategories.description: When true, spending in descendant categories counts against this line.

remainingAmount.description: Negative once the line is overspent.

status.description: Derived from spend against limit; never sent by a caller.

periodProgressPercent.description: How much of the period has elapsed, so a client can show pace against spend.

depth.description: 0 for a top-level category, 2 at the deepest the schema allows.

isSystem.description: Seeded from the default template when the workspace was created.

depth.description: 0 for a top-level category, 2 at the deepest the schema allows.

isSystem.description: Seeded from the default template when the workspace was created.

decimalDigits.description: The minor unit — 2 for most currencies, 0 for JPY.

DateOnly.description: A calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. No time, no zone.

code.description: The stable, machine-readable member of the error taxonomy.

message.description: A sentence for a person, rendered in the locale resolved from the profile or `Accept-Language`. Match on `code`, never on this.

details.description: Present on a field-validation failure: one entry per rejected field.

path.description: Dotted path, prefixed by the request part: `body.name`.

requestId.description: Correlates the response with the server log line; also sent as `x-request-id`.

accountId.description: The account the goal is saved into, when one was named.

requiredMonthlyContribution.description: What it now takes each month to hit the target by `targetDate`. Null without a deadline.

offTrack.description: True when the goal is behind the pace its deadline implies.

transactionId.description: Set when the contribution was recorded against a ledger row.

ImportColumnMapping.description: Field name to zero-based column index. An absent key is an unmapped field.

ImportOptions.description: How the file was read, echoed back so nothing about the parse is implicit.

dateFormat.description: `dmy` and `mdy` are the two readings of `01/02/2026`.

signConvention.description: One signed column, separate debit/credit columns, or a magnitude plus a D/C flag.

batchId.description: The preview id and the batch id are the same thing; commit takes it.

mappingRecalled.description: The mapping came from this account's last import rather than a guess.

dateFormatAmbiguous.description: The file reads either way round and nothing in it settles it. Ask before committing.

lineNumber.description: 1-based line in the source file, header included, so it matches a text editor.

amount.description: Signed, in the account's currency: negative is money leaving.

categoryName.description: The file's own category text when it matched nothing here.

duplicateOfTransactionId.description: An existing ledger row this looks like.

duplicateOfLineNumber.description: An earlier row of this same file this looks like.

raw.description: The unparsed fields, so the client can show what it read.

message.description: Already rendered in the request's locale.

Money.description: A decimal amount as a string, never a JSON number. Stored as NUMERIC(19,4).

workspaceId.description: Null for a notice about the account rather than about a workspace.

type.description: The alert rule type that raised it, or a system event name.

title.description: Already rendered in the recipient's language.

message.description: Already rendered in the recipient's language.

data.description: Whatever the rule attached — amounts, ids — for a client to link from.

expenses.description: Positive: the magnitude spent, not the signed ledger total.

savingsRate.description: Net as a percentage of income. 0 when there was no income.

status.description: `completed` only when the two balances matched exactly.

accountName.description: Joined by the list and detail queries only.

categoryName.description: Joined by the list and detail queries only.

amount.description: Signed as stored — negative for an expense — unlike the create/update input.

nextOccurrenceOn.description: Null once the schedule is finished or inactive.

autoPost.description: True posts generated rows as `cleared`; false leaves them `scheduled` for confirmation.

leadTimeDays.description: How far ahead of the due date a row is generated.

summary.description: The schedule in words, e.g. "Monthly on the 1st". Already translated.

usageCount.description: How many transactions carry the tag. Listing only.

accountName.description: Joined by the list and detail queries only.

amount.description: Signed as stored: negative for an expense, positive for income.

baseAmount.description: The same amount in the workspace's base currency, converted on the day it happened.

exchangeRate.description: The rate that applied on `occurredOn`, to ten decimal places.

transferGroupId.description: Both legs of a transfer share one group id.

tags.description: Tag names, attached by the list and detail queries only.

deletedAt.description: Set on a soft-deleted row. Only `?includeDeleted=true` returns one; `POST /:id/restore` undoes it.

sharePercent.description: Present when the split was made by weight.

locale.description: A BCP 47 tag. The API answers in it when `Accept-Language` says nothing.

emailVerifiedAt.description: Null until the emailed link is confirmed.

baseCurrency.description: Every analytic figure in this workspace is expressed in it.

role.description: The calling user's role here, not a property of the workspace.
Ownership moves through its own endpoint, so it cannot be invited to.

id.description: The membership row, not the user.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed — unparseable JSON, or a value the database refused outright.

Unauthorized.description: No bearer token was sent, or it has expired or belongs to an inactive account.

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated but lacks the required role in this workspace.

NotFound.description: No such resource, or none the caller is allowed to know exists.

Conflict.description: The write collided with an existing row, such as a duplicate name.

ValidationFailed.description: One or more fields were rejected. `error.details` names each one, already translated into the language resolved for the request.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests; the caller has exceeded the rate limit for this window.

InternalError.description: Something failed inside the API. The message is fixed and the detail stays in the logs.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The request took too long and was abandoned before a response was ready.

200.description: Liveness. Deliberately dependency-free, so a database blip cannot get a healthy container restarted.
